errors.notOpen: This competition is not accepting registrations

register.emailWhy: The email is how the same person is recognised. It is what decides the surcharge when they enter a second division.
register.feeExtraNote: If this email already entered another division, {amount} is added
register.signInFirst: Entering means signing in. First time here? Create an account, build your roster, and from then on it is ticking names.
register.rosterEmpty: Your roster is empty. Build it first, then come back and tick names.
register.manageRoster: Add or edit people in your roster

payment.sandboxNotice: Test mode: no real money will be taken.
payment.redirecting: Taking you to the payment page…

admin.title: Organiser
admin.tokenMissing: No organiser passcode (ADMIN_TOKEN) is set, so the back office is disabled.
admin.markPaidHint: For cash or bank transfer. These payments do not go through a payment provider.
admin.resettleHint: Use after a late entry, withdrawal or refund. The old voucher code stops working immediately.
admin.voucherNone: No voucher code yet. Bibs, running order, floor control, judging and results all need one before they will run.
admin.cannotResettle: Judging has started, so this competition can no longer be re-settled.
admin.paymentKeysHint: Keys live only in the host environment. They are never stored in the database or in the source code.
admin.settled: Voucher issued. Bibs, running order, floor control, judging and results can now run.
admin.feeHint: The default entry fee. A division may set its own; leave that blank to use this one.
admin.divisionHint: The member range is what makes a division a solo, a couple or a team. Everyone in a division pays the same.
admin.membersHint: 1 to 1 for a solo, 2 to 2 for a couple, 3 to 24 for a team; 3 to 3 if it must be exactly three. The ceiling is 24.
admin.divisionFeeHint: Leave blank to use the competition's default fee.
admin.extraDivisionFeeHint: What a person pays on top from their second division onwards. A negative number is a discount. People are matched by email, never by name.
admin.divisionExists: There is already a division with that name.
admin.divisionInUse: Somebody has entered this division, so it cannot be deleted.
admin.noDivisions: No divisions yet. Add one so people have something to enter.
admin.ageBasisYearEnd: Age on 31 December of the competition year
admin.ageBasisEventDay: Age on the day of the competition
admin.ageBasisHint: Pick 31 December to keep everyone born in the same year together; pick the day for actual ages.
admin.eventDateHint: The date of the competition. Left blank, ages are counted as of today.
admin.ageLimitsHint: Blank means no limit. Entries are checked against the competitor’s date of birth.
admin.resetPasswordHint: Issues a temporary password to hand over in person or by phone. They must choose their own at the next sign-in.
admin.feeGroupsHint: Many competitions charge a base fee covering a few items, then so much per extra item. Pro-am entries must not be counted with the ordinary ones, so give them a plan of their own and each counts separately.
admin.noFeeGroups: No fee plans yet. A competition charging per entry or per person needs none.
admin.feeGroupAddHint: For example 1800 covering 2 items, then 600 each. One division counts as one item.
admin.feeGroupSummary: {base} covers {includes} item(s); from item {next} onwards, {extra} each.
admin.feeGroupInUse: Divisions still use this plan. Move them off it first.
admin.feeGroupPickHint: A division following a plan takes its price from the plan; the entry fee above is ignored.
admin.tieredNeedsGroup: Set to follow a plan, but no plan chosen.

errors.mergeNeedsTwo: Choose at least two heats to merge.
errors.mergeSameDance: Only heats of the same dance can be merged.

results.tieAtCut: There is a tie at the qualifying line.
results.notFound: No result for that bib number.

errors.voided: You are voided for this heat and can no longer score it.
errors.overQuota: That is over the mark quota (limit {limit}, now {used}).
errors.duplicateRank: Place {rank} has already been given to someone else.
errors.badPoints: That score is not a valid number.
errors.badRank: That place is not a valid number.

rounds.suggestFreePass: {present} present for {count} places. Dancing it eliminates nobody, so a free pass is suggested.
rounds.decisionHint: A free pass means the round is not danced and everyone present goes through. Straight to the final skips the rounds in between. Both are recorded, and the published results say so.

errors.alreadyStarted: This round has started scoring and can no longer be changed.
errors.noNextRound: There is no later round to advance into.
errors.badAdvanceCount: The number of places must be 1 or more.

entrant.title: Your entries
entrant.signUpWhy: A studio or parent creates one account and builds a roster. Every competition after that is a matter of ticking names.
entrant.emailWhy: This is your account. The competitors themselves need no email address.
entrant.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
entrant.mustChangePassword: The organiser has reset your password. Please choose a new one.
entrant.forgotPassword: Forgotten your password? Ask the organiser to issue a temporary one.

errors.emailInvalid: That email address does not look right.
errors.emailTaken: That email is already registered. Please sign in.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
errors.badCredentials: That email or password is wrong.

roster.title: Roster
roster.hint: Build the roster once and reuse it. Entering a competition is then a matter of ticking names.
roster.empty: The roster is empty. Add the first competitor.
roster.name: Name
roster.addHint: Press Enter to save; the cursor returns to the name so you can keep going.

errors.birthDateInvalid: That date of birth does not look right.
errors.birthDateFuture: A date of birth cannot be in the future.
errors.duplicate: The roster already has a "{name}" with that same birthday.

setup.title: Build the divisions
setup.intro: Is this the same event you have run before?
setup.copyFrom: Same as before — copy it across
setup.copyHint: Dances, fee plans, divisions and each division’s dance list come across. Entries and results do not.
setup.firstTime: First time — start from a template
setup.firstTimeHint: Pick a template and the divisions are generated for you; switch off the ones you are not running. Far quicker than building from an empty page.
setup.chooseHint: Everything starts switched on. Untick what you are not running. Three-dance events are not offered because the combination differs by region; add them by hand afterwards.
setup.summary: This competition has {divisions} divisions on {groups} fee plan(s).
setup.clearHint: While nobody has entered, everything can be cleared and rebuilt. It locks once the first entry arrives.
setup.locked: Somebody has entered, so the divisions are locked.

errors.alreadyHasDivisions: This competition already has divisions. Clear them first to rebuild.
errors.alreadyEntered: Somebody has entered, so this cannot be cleared.
errors.sameCompetition: A competition cannot be copied onto itself.
